concept: S3 Object Lock: compliance mode (WORM) for immutable storage
tests: How to guarantee S3 objects can't be deleted or overwritten during the retention period, even by administrators.
expected: S3 Object Lock in compliance mode — WORM; no one (including root) can shorten or bypass retention. Triggers: "cannot be deleted or overwritten", "even by administrators", "regulatory compliance".
why_not: Versioning alone doesn't prevent deletion; lifecycle manages transitions and expiration; an administrator can change a bucket policy. (Governance mode — privileged users can bypass it.)
